What happens when you roll

Dice rolls are generated on your device using your browser’s cryptographic random number generator. Rolla has no user accounts, analytics, advertising pixels or application backend. The app does not upload your results, favorites or preferences. Fonts and other app assets are served with the website, without requests to an external font provider.

Cookies and storage on your device

The Rolla application sets no cookies. It uses browser local storage to remember your privacy choice and, only if you choose “Allow saving”, your favorites, roll history and settings. Before you choose, or if you select “Essential only”, those optional features use memory for the current page session and are not saved for later visits.

StoragePurpose and retention
rolla.consentYour allow/essential-only choice and expiry, without a unique visitor ID. Valid for 180 days, then you are asked again. This is necessary to respect your choice.
rolla.favoritesUp to 12 named dice combinations, only with permission.
rolla.historyThe last 30 rolls, including outcomes, time, settings and which dice were held, only with permission. Older rolls are replaced.
rolla.skin
rolla.sound
rolla.moments		Your dice skin, sound and visual-effects preferences, only with permission.

Optional saving relies on your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and § 165(3) Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021 where applicable. The privacy choice itself is necessary to implement your request. Optional data stays on this browser/device until you remove it, withdraw consent, clear browser data, or return after your choice has expired. When consent expires, optional saved data is removed on your next visit before it is read.

You can reopen at any time. Choosing “Essential only” removes Rolla’s optional saved data from this browser. Existing session data remains available until the page is closed or reloaded. You can also remove individual favorites or clear history in the app. Your choice does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. If browser storage is unavailable, the app works for the current session.

Website hosting

The public website is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc., USA. When you load the site, GitHub receives the technical request information needed to deliver its files. GitHub states that visitors’ IP addresses are logged and stored for security, including when visitors are not signed in to GitHub. Rolla’s operator does not receive these logs through the app.

Delivering and securing the website serves our legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. GitHub processes data internationally, including in the United States. Its Privacy Statement explains its data handling, retention criteria and transfer safeguards. See also GitHub Pages data collection. We do not control GitHub’s hosting-log retention.

If you contact us

If you email us, we process your contact details and message to respond to your request. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in handling correspondence (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), or Article 6(1)(b) GDPR where your enquiry concerns a contract. Correspondence is retained for as long as needed to handle the enquiry and meet applicable legal retention duties.

The contact mailbox uses helloly GmbH, Rainerstrasse 25, 4020 Linz, Austria, and Microsoft Outlook. Depending on the email service’s operation, mailbox data may be synchronized with Microsoft’s cloud services. These services are used for correspondence, not loaded merely by visiting Rolla. See helloly’s privacy information and Microsoft’s Privacy Statement.

Your rights

Where the GDPR applies and its conditions are met, you have rights of access, correction, erasure, restriction and data portability. You may withdraw consent at any time and object to processing based on legitimate interests. Use the contact details above for requests; browser-only saved data can be removed directly through the app or your browser.

You may lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, including the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Datenschutzbehörde). Rolla does not carry out advertising profiling or automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.
